controls.title: Tenant context is propagated
controls.rationale: Authenticated tenant context must survive service boundaries.

controls.title: Cross-tenant access is denied
controls.rationale: Tenant isolation is a foundational SaaS security boundary.

controls.title: Workload credentials are tenant scoped
controls.rationale: Scoped sessions reduce broad resource access.

controls.title: Data access enforces tenant identity
controls.rationale: Data-layer controls reduce reliance on application-only checks.

controls.title: Human access uses federation
controls.rationale: Federation reduces long-lived workforce IAM users.

controls.title: Workloads use short-lived credentials
controls.rationale: Short-lived credentials reduce persistent exposure.

controls.title: Least-privilege review is performed
controls.rationale: Permissions should be periodically constrained.

controls.title: IAM Access Analyzer is enabled
controls.rationale: Access Analyzer surfaces unintended access.

controls.title: Application workloads are private
controls.rationale: Internet exposure should be concentrated at managed ingress.

controls.title: Datastores are private
controls.rationale: Tenant data should not require direct public reachability.

controls.title: VPC Flow Logs are enabled
controls.rationale: Network telemetry supports investigation.

controls.title: TLS is enforced
controls.rationale: Data should be protected in transit.

controls.title: Encryption at rest is enabled
controls.rationale: Persistent sensitive data should use managed encryption.

controls.title: Audit evidence uses customer-managed KMS
controls.rationale: Separately governed audit encryption improves visibility.

controls.title: Secrets are managed outside source
controls.rationale: Secrets should not live in repositories or images.

controls.title: CloudTrail is multi-Region
controls.rationale: Multi-Region logging reduces audit blind spots.

controls.title: CloudTrail validation is enabled
controls.rationale: Validation supports integrity-aware audit review.

controls.title: Audit archive is private and versioned
controls.rationale: Audit evidence should resist casual overwrite or public exposure.

controls.title: GuardDuty is enabled
controls.rationale: Managed detection adds account and workload signals.

controls.title: Security Hub is enabled
controls.rationale: Centralized findings support posture workflows.

controls.title: Findings have an owned response route
controls.rationale: Detection needs ownership and escalation.

controls.title: Incident-response roles are defined
controls.rationale: Security events need clear responsibility.

controls.title: Response playbooks are exercised
controls.rationale: Untested response should not be treated as demonstrated.

controls.title: Architecture evidence is maintained
controls.rationale: Customer claims should be grounded in reviewable evidence.

controls.title: Questionnaire answers require evidence
controls.rationale: Trust workflows should not convert assumptions into yes answers.

controls.title: Security exceptions have accountable owners
controls.rationale: Exceptions should remain visible and owned.
